title: Packing list
error: The packing list couldn't be loaded. Check your connection, then try again.
notFound: This trip wasn't found. It may have been deleted.
notReady: The packing list is built from the dates and the group. Finish the plan first.
saveFailed: The change wasn't saved. Check your connection, then try again.
offline: Offline. Changes are kept on this device and sent once you're back online.
offlineUnavailable: There's no connection, and this list was never opened on this device.

empty.other: Nothing on the list matches this filter.

add.label: Add your own item
add.full: That's {count} added items. Remove one to add another.

laundry.title: Clothes for {days} days: how will you manage?
laundry.hint: The count assumes 2 to 3 outfits a day. For more than a week, pick a way.

stops.drop: Drop off the group's dirty clothes and ask when they will be ready. At a coin laundry the wash can be done the same day.
stops.pick: Collect the clean clothes dropped off yesterday and bring the receipt. Skip this if the wash already came back with you.
stops.wash: Wash tonight so the clothes are dry before the clean ones run out.

plan.laundry: Added to the itinerary: drop-off on day {days}, pick-up the day after.
plan.wash: Added to the itinerary: an evening of washing on day {days}.
plan.waiting: No connection. The laundry stops join the itinerary once you are back online.
plan.failed: The nearest laundry couldn't be looked up, so it is not in the itinerary yet.
plan.noItinerary: There is no itinerary yet. The laundry stops are added when it is made.

weather.title: Weather in {place}
weather.unavailable: The weather couldn't be fetched, so nothing for the weather is on the list yet.
weather.typical: Marked "usually": the weather on the same date last year. The forecast appears 16 days ahead.

captain.pending: Captain is reading your group's notes.
captain.failed: Captain couldn't add suggestions. This list is still complete from its basic rules.

added.one: Captain added {count} item from what you wrote and planned.
added.other: Captain added {count} items from what you wrote and planned.

captain.none: Captain has read your plan. There is nothing to add.

items.dryBag: Waterproof pouch for phones and papers
items.babyMeds: Children's fever medicine and a thermometer
items.kidPlay: Toys or books for the road
items.contactCard: Name card and emergency number in a pocket
items.regularMeds: Regular medication for every day, plus spare
items.medNotes: Copy of prescriptions and the doctor's number
items.toiletKit: Tissues, hand sanitizer, and spare underwear
items.allergyCard: Allergy card to show at restaurants
